title: linnet · Half-edge graph
summary: Stores graph topology as paired half-edges with independent edge, vertex, and half-edge payloads.

title: linnet · Half-edge graph.edge_store
summary: Internal storage for all half-edges, their data, and their topological relationships (e.g., opposite half-edge, next half-edge around a node). This is typically a [`SmartHedgeVec<E>`].

title: linnet · Half-edge graph.node_store
summary: Storage for all nodes in the graph, including their data (`V`) and information about the half-edges incident to them. The specific implementation is determined by the `S` type parameter.

title: linnet · Graph builder
summary: Builds a valid half-edge graph while assigning typed node, edge, and hedge identifiers.

title: linnet · Graph builder.nodes
summary: A list of nodes currently being built, stored as [`HedgeNodeBuilder`] instances.

title: linnet · Graph builder.involution
summary: The [`Involution`] structure managing the half-edges being added to the graph.

title: linnet · Bit-vector subgraph
summary: Represents a subgraph as an efficient half-edge inclusion filter.

title: linnet · Traversal tree
summary: Records parent, root, and traversal information produced by breadth-first or depth-first graph walks.

title: linnet · Traversal tree.forest
summary: The underlying forest structure representing the traversal tree(s). Each root in this forest is a graph node, and its data is its [`TTRoot`] status. Nodes within each tree of this forest represent half-edges.

title: linnet · Traversal tree.tree_subgraph
summary: A bitmask representing the set of half-edges that constitute the actual edges of this traversal tree.

title: linnet · DOT-backed graph
summary: Combines a half-edge graph with DOT attributes and parser/serializer support.
